games.description: Three solo sessions through a sprawling Chinese horror comedy. Haunted-house keys and badly translated clues open into hospital secrets, ghost rescues and the five magic balls, ending with the return-to-reality choices and their consequences.

games.description: A co-op test of DIG Games’ 2024 ghost-investigation game with NFEN, APL Fisher and Bruce Greene. The group learn the equipment, struggle with key bindings and resets, and compare ghost guesses and uneven rewards before stopping.
games.title: Ghost Hunters

games.description: Two crews try to escape a vampire’s prison by finding tools, moving fuses, solving codes and reviving one another. The later return revisits the police-station escape and its unreliable power system.
